text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Paper-figure_1_fable'; text-anchor: start; fill: #142d40

g.text: 1 · A fable, an action request, two actual outputs
A: text → pre-extraction → fixed selection B: text + question → extraction

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Paper-figure_1_fable'; text-anchor: start; fill: #315d82

g.text: SOURCE EXCERPT · S1–S5; final speech S6 omitted here, supplied to model

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Paper-figure_1_fable'; text-anchor: start; fill: #315d82

g.text: A LION was awakened from sleep by a Mouse running over his face.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Paper-figure_1_fable'; text-anchor: start; fill: #315d82

g.text: Rising up angrily, he caught him and was about to kill him, when the Mouse piteously entreated,
saying: “If you would only spare my life, I would be sure to repay your kindness.”

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Paper-figure_1_fable'; text-anchor: start; fill: #315d82

g.text: The Lion laughed and let him go.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Paper-figure_1_fable'; text-anchor: start; fill: #315d82

g.text: It happened shortly after this that the Lion was caught by some hunters, who bound him by strong

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Paper-figure_1_fable'; text-anchor: start; fill: #315d82

g.text: The Mouse, recognizing his roar, came and gnawed the rope with his teeth, and set him free,

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Paper-figure_1_fable'; text-anchor: start; fill: #142d40

g.text: REQUEST · Physical running, capture, binding, gnawing and release
